nav.tagline: Your whole campus in one app

hero.title: Your whole campus in one app
hero.subtitle: Timetable, carpools, course notes, room bookings and announcements, together in one place and available even without a network.

modules.title: Ten modules, one login
modules.subtitle: Everything a school community needs day to day, in a single app.

timetable.title: Smart timetable
timetable.text: Generated for your program, with a push notification whenever a class or room changes.

rooms.title: Rooms and equipment
rooms.text: A shared calendar that catches booking conflicts before they happen.

carpool.title: Carpooling
carpool.text: Find rides from students near you and chat in the app.

notes.title: Notes marketplace
notes.text: Upload and rate course notes. Payments are simulated.

forum.title: Help forum
forum.text: Ask and answer by subject. Votes and badges surface the best replies.

alumni.title: Alumni network
alumni.text: Browse profiles and ask a graduate to mentor you.

progress.title: Your progress
progress.text: Track attendance and follow your progress in simple charts.

announcements.title: Announcements
announcements.text: Admins send push notifications targeted by program.

offline.title: Full offline mode
offline.text: Cached pages and background sync keep you going without signal.

auth.title: Sign-in and roles
auth.text: Secure sign-in with separate access for students, teachers, alumni and admins.

offline.title: Made for patchy campus Wi-Fi
offline.subtitle: CampusLink installs like a native app and keeps working when the network does not.

lose.title: You lose the signal
lose.text: Your timetable and saved pages stay readable.

keep.title: You keep going
keep.text: Bookings and posts wait in a queue on your device.

cta.title: Bring your school onto CampusLink
cta.subtitle: Create your account and see your timetable in a minute.
